files.purpose: AdrenoTools Vulkan driver for an owner-installed Eden on the Adreno 613; the stock driver crashes Eden's VulkanWorker

owner_installed.dev.legacy.eden_emulator: Nintendo Switch emulator. Not redistributed in the image (yuzu-derived project with a takedown history); the owner installs it, see docs/APPS.md. The Nano Switch entry and Eden defaults activate only once it is installed.
